title: Keep wake time within a 45-minute window.
subtitle: Sleep anchor
rationale: A stable wake time keeps the circadian system anchored even when bedtime drifts.

evidence.summary: Consistent sleep and wake timing is associated with better health, safety, and performance.

sources.label: Sleep timing and consistency systematic review

indications: Wake time varies 45 to 90 minutes across the week.
Mornings feel inconsistent despite adequate sleep duration.
